task.title: P6-150: Batch move picks quantity and version per entry
task.description:
Feature story from the P6-150 ruling (maintainer, 2026-08-15): a tray entry is a card; the move flow must let the user choose HOW MANY copies move and WHICH version (finish/condition/language) when a row spans several. All-or-nothing does not serve the point of moving cards between collections — today every entry moves exactly one copy, fixed server-side, and multi-grain stacks with no default grain are refused outright.

The ruling settles the four questions the old decision task bundled: (1) the tray keeps counting entries (cards) — fine as-is; (2) quantity is chosen at move time, per entry; (3) /my-vs-collection duplicate entries collapse in the move step's stack resolution; (4) multi-grain rows stay selectable — the move step asks which grain instead of refusing.

Build on the existing which-copies step (app/src/my/move_selection.rs, WhichCopiesDialog): it already shows concrete stacks per (collection, printing, board) with counts + checkboxes and re-submits through the same write path.

Acceptance criteria:
- Which-copies rows split to full grain — (collection, printing, board, finish, condition, language) — so 2 foil + 1 etched render as two rows; the surviving SkipReason::Grain refusal disappears because the picker asks instead.
- Each picker row carries a quantity stepper 0..=stack count (default 1, the small-blast-radius precedent), replacing the bare checkbox.
- SelectedCard / shared MoveItem carry a quantity; the server validates it against actual ungrouped holdings per entry and refuses politely per entry (Skipped reporting and batch survival preserved).
- SELECTION_MOVE_QUANTITY = 1 removed; the toast reports copies actually moved (e.g. 'Moved 5 copies of 3 cards') instead of '(1 copy each)'.
- Undo remains one action over the whole batch (undo_moves), reversing full quantities.
- Routing: entries with a quantity choice (stack count > 1) or any ambiguity go through the picker; a batch of only single-copy unambiguous entries may keep the direct path.
- e2e coverage per the e2e-suite skill; mobile-relevant, so exercise on the Android emulator via android-smoke.

Specs: specs/app-ui.md (Selection tray), specs/collection-api.md (Move (batch)) — update both with the ruling as part of the work.
